key_insight: The paper focuses on assessing how aluminium-to-steel welded joints behave under multiaxial fatigue loading, which is critical for predicting real service-life performance.
engineering_relevance: Its findings are relevant for designing lighter hybrid metal structures where welded joints must withstand complex cyclic stresses in transportation, manufacturing, and structural applications.
method: Evaluates multiaxial fatigue behavior of aluminium-to-steel welded joints.
Uses a welding- and fatigue-assessment-oriented analysis framework.
Draws on journal-indexed research from White Rose Research Online.
